description: Details pursuant to the discharge of Condition 17 (Land Contamination and Remediation Method Statement) of planning permission ref. 23658/APP/2023/2980 dated 11-10-2024 (Minor Material Amendment (S73) to Conditions 2 (Approved Plans), 3 (Approved Documents) and 23 (Landscaping Scheme for Health Centre Development) of planning permission ref. 23658/APP/2021/1296, granted 31-08-2023 for: Partial demolition, refurbishment and extension of the existing Cottage Hospital to provide a state of the art health centre and the comprehensive redevelopment of the remaining Site to provide residential (Use Class C3) accommodation and ancillary works including car parking, cycle parking, landscaping and associated works (Phased Development)
application_type_full: Approval of details reserved by a condition (discharge)
decision_conditions: The approval of details pursuant to Condition 17 under application ref. 23658/APP/2026/1339 relates only to the Health Centre phase of the development. The applicant is reminded that this discharge is based on the submitted verification report and associated documentation demonstrating compliance with the approved remediation strategy for the Health Centre site. This decision does not discharge any land contamination requirements that may apply to other phases of the wider development, which will need to be addressed separately where required.
